# mooncake selfbuild

Cross-compile mooncake for every target into ~/.mooncake/bin

## Description

Builds mooncake for each fleet target platform (linux/darwin/windows × amd64/arm64) and writes them to the ~/.mooncake/bin store as mooncake_<os>_<arch>[.exe]. fleet bootstrap resolves the right binary from this store by detected target platform. Must run inside the mooncake source tree (needs the Go toolchain). Use --only to build a subset.

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--only` | string | - | Comma-separated os/arch list to build (e.g. windows/amd64,linux/arm64); default all |
| `--source` | string | - | Path to the mooncake module root (default: search upward from cwd) |
